# retroarch-assets

The Games page's controller icons (`app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/ic_system_*.png`) are
libretro's XMB monochrome system icons, from `src/xmb/monochrome/*.svg` in
https://github.com/libretro/retroarch-assets, drawn at the size the page shows them.
They are licensed CC-BY 4.0 (see COPYING).
